title: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, 6.6 Methods of Savings: Distinguish various basic forms of savings plans.
summary: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, 6.6 Methods of Savings: Distinguish various basic forms of savings plans.
body: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, section "6.6 Methods of Savings", prints these objectives: "Distinguish various basic forms of savings plans." "Compute return on investment for basic forms of savings plans." "Compute payment to reach a financial goal.". This card reports that page.
